content.text: Review the current changes that are committed for the renovate file and make sure that we do want to push them to the remote and that there are not updates that we would be pushing unnecessarily.
I'll look at what's committed but not yet pushed, then review the renovate config diff.

input.command: git fetch --quiet && git status -sb && echo "--- unpushed commits ---" && git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD && echo "--- files in unpushed commits ---" && git diff --stat origin/main..HEAD

name: Renovate Config
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - ".github/renovate-config.json"
      - "renovate.json"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # renovate: datasource=npm depName=renovate
      RENOVATE_VERSION: 43.288.0
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Validate repository config
        run: npx --yes --package "renovate@${RENOVATE_VERSION}" renovate-config-validator --strict
      - name: Validate Renovate bot config
        run: npx --yes --package "renovate@${RENOVATE_VERSION}" renovate-config-validator --strict .github/renovate-config.json
name: Renovate
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      overrideSchedule:
        description: "Override all schedules"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 4,6 * * *"
permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  renovate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Run Renovate
        uses: renovatebot/github-action@37beffda261423addd537c33f2d126df7f6ffbab # v46.2.6
        env:
          RENOVATE_FORCE: ${{ inputs.overrideSchedule == true && '{''schedule'':null}' || '' }}
          RENOVATE_HOST_RULES: >-
            [{"hostType":"docker","matchHost":"ghcr.io","username":"mich-murphy","password":"${{ secrets.RENOVATE_TOKEN }}"}]
        with:
          configurationFile: .github/renovate-config.json
          token: ${{ secrets.RENOVATE_TOKEN }}

input.description: Read Renovate PR automerge decision logic

content.text:
The commit is safe to push as far as scope goes, but it changes automerge behaviour more than the message "better accuracy" suggests. Nothing was modified locally.

**What is unpushed.** Only one commit is ahead of origin/main, and it touches only `renovate.json`. No other changes would ride along.

**What the config change actually does.** Before, only digest bumps were automerged, and the high-risk list (postgres, mariadb, redis, traefik, Immich, Terraform providers) blocked automerge for every update type. After, patch releases for every package automerge, including the high-risk list. Immich server and machine-learning lose their dedicated manual-approval rule and now automerge on patch too. The dropped digest preset is fully covered by the new final rule, and the pin types are no-ops since all 36 images are already digest-pinned.

**Things worth knowing before pushing.**

- **Automerge merges instantly and skips CI.** The main ruleset requires a PR but no status checks, so GitHub's native auto-merge fires the moment Renovate opens the PR. Past digest PRs merged within seconds of creation. Patch bumps to databases will now do the same without the quality gate running.
- **Merge equals deploy.** Portainer GitOps polls main for 13 application stacks, so an automerged postgres, mariadb, or redis patch restarts those containers unattended. The init stack with Traefik is Ansible-owned, so Traefik patches only land on the next Ansible run.
- **Build-only rebuilds count as patch.** Renovate types the linuxserver `-lsNNN` and Plex build bumps as patch, so those will automerge. You have been merging them by hand every few days, so this is probably the intended win.
- **Open PRs are unaffected.** Redis 8.10.1 and Immich 3.1.0 are minor updates on high-risk packages and stay manual. The Ansible collection patch PR has failing checks, so Renovate's own automerge path will not merge it. Whether GitHub-native auto-merge gets retroactively enabled on it I could not confirm from the source.

**Recommendation.** If you are happy for database patch releases to auto-deploy, push as is. If not, either add `patch` to the high-risk rule's update types for just the database images, or add required status checks to the main ruleset so auto-merge waits for the quality gate. The second option also fixes the pre-existing gap for digest updates.
